nodes.title: Accountancy / Book

nodes.label: I
nodes.title: Accounting for Partnership
Nature of Partnership Firm: Partnership deed (meaning, importance).
Accounts of Partnership: Fixed v/s Fluctuating capital, Division of profit among partners,
nodes.body: Profit and Loss Appropriation account, guarantee of profit to a partner, past adjustments.

nodes.label: II
nodes.title: Reconstitution of a Partnership firm
Changes in profit sharing ratio among the existing partners – Sacrificing ratio and Gaining
Accounting for Revaluation of Assets and reassessment of Liabilities and Distribution of
Goodwill: Nature, Factors affecting and Methods of valuation: Average profit, Super profit
Admission of a Partner: Effect of admission of partner, Change in profit sharing ratio,
nodes.body: Accounting treatment for goodwill, Revaluation of assets and reassessment of liabilities, Reserves adjustment/distribution of (accumulated profits) and adjustment of capitals.

nodes.title: Retirement/Death of a Partner: Change in profit sharing ratio, Accounting treatment of
nodes.body: goodwill, Revaluation of assets and reassessment of liabilities, Adjustment of Accumulated profits (Reserves), Preparation of deceased partner’s capital account and his executor’s account, Preparation of Loan Account.

nodes.label: III
nodes.title: Dissolution of Partnership Firm
Meaning, Settlement of accounts: Preparation of Realisation Account and related Accounts
nodes.body: (excluding piecemeal distribution, sale to a company and insolvency of a Partner).

nodes.label: IV
nodes.title: Company Accounts: Accounting for Share and Debenture Capital
Features and type of companies.
Share Capital: Meaning, Nature and Types
Accounting for Share Capital: Issue and Allotment of Equity and Preference Shares; Over
nodes.body: subscription and Under subscription; Issue at par and premium; Calls in advance, Calls in arrears, Issue of shares for consideration other than cash.

nodes.title: Accounting treatment of Forfeiture of Shares and Re-issue of forfeited shares.
Presentation of shares capital and Debentures in company’s balance sheet.
Issue of Debenture – At par, premium and discount; Issue of debentures for consideration
nodes.body: other than cash. Issue of debentures with terms of redemption, Debenture as collateral security- concept, Interest on debentures, writing off discount/Loss on issues of debenture.

Financial Statements of a Company: Preparation of simple financial statements of a

Accounting Ratios: Meaning and Objectives and types: Liquidity Ratio, Solvency Ratio,
Cash Flow Statement: Meaning and Objectives, Preparation, Adjustments related to
nodes.body: depreciation, amortization, dividend and tax, purchase and profit or loss on sale of non- current assets (as per revised standard issued by ICAI). Optional to Unit V
